title: feature refine outcome
description: The outcome of `bl refine F-n` (feature-refine.md), written by the agent to the outcome file. `bl refine` sets the feature's status from it (F-68 D3).

summary.description: One line: what the session decided and planned.

premise_holds.description: false: the premise does not hold, and bl sets the feature's status to draft.

refined.description: true (with premise_holds true): the feature is ready for approval, and bl sets its status to refined. false: bl leaves the status and prints the reason.

reason.description: Why the premise does not hold or the feature is not refined, in one line. Required unless premise_holds and refined are both true.
